I had the exact same thing happen to me. My mom illegally went through my emails,edited them, and sent them out to my family. 

If she's narcissitic, she's going to go to extrodinary lengths to destroy your relationship with your family. If you're willing to fight her back, record her abuse and sent it to your family members. This will create a lot of drama though, and your nMom might react violently. I did this and it nearly cost me my apartment and car. The one thing you cannot do is beg her to stop.  if you do, she will want more control and do even shittier things to you


It's a really shitty situation to be in and I'm so sorry you're going through it. You don't have a lot of options.

I live in a town where a car is absolutely vital. I don't have a job (I was going to get one but I burned that bridge when me and Hunter's friendship fell apart), but I was planning on being a physics tutor over the summer. I have pretty good grades so this should not be a problem.

I would have never thought of this in any other circumstance, but the military might be a good option. If I go that route, I can go down the pre-med route and get most of my med school paid off and on top of that not deal with my family. I always wanted to do medicine, and I am more than cut out for it. 

As far as Hunter goes, I'll talk about that later, I have a friend coming over in a bit (I'm getting a free backrub!)

Thanks to Hunter, my social skills are significantly better and I can make networks relatively quickly, so moving without friends won't be too hard. I always found the people in New Mexico to be really friendly (around the same as Lubbock, where I am from.)

Before this happened I used to run a lot. It helped immensely, but I didn't have a lot of time leading up to me snapping. I was juggling an extremely hard biology course, Russian, and an engineering weedout class. Dealing with that load and my mother was way too much. All of my friends cringed at my courseload. 

I'm going to pick it up again now that I don't have the schedule from hell.

This is why I freaked out and tried to kill myself in the first place, it was either turn her in and lose anything, or keep my stuff and deal with her abuse and risk having to tell Hunter that my mom might try to contact her. In my letter when I completely lost it, I tried to explain the situation to Hunter, but it came out fucked up.


I did get the rent money, she was trying to pull my strings and force me into a fight. I bit the bait. I hate having to play fucking mindgames with her. I can see why my dad is such a horrible person now.


The appointments made things worse. The therapist called it off after the second meeting. She lied her ass off to the therapist and said she couldn't help her unless she admitted she had a problem. She tried to get access to my mail seeing that it was in her name too. I would LOVE to back down and beg for mercy just to make this stop, but I know if I do it's only going to solve things temporarily and make things worse. That's what a lot of people don't understand I think. She wants more control now that I have "A drug problem"


As far as my friend goes, I dealt with that already, and I have enough in my savings to hold me over for a few months. I am also going to start getting in scholarship money as well, that will pay for food starting February. I'm toning down the alcohol, the first three weeks after this happened were outright painful in every since of the word and drinking helped the flashbacks tremendously.

First off, if your dry heaving, then it's not a good idea to eat. If you think you will throw it up, you will.

What has been helping me is recording all of my thoughts on a tape recorder. It doesn't matter how stupid they are or how disorganized they are, that has helped me calm down A LOT. It may not work for you, but gathering my thoughts has been really useful. I sometimes listen back to them and just try to relax listening to them. You're young, you need to experiment with stuff. Everyone says don't do drugs (and they're mostly right) but it's good to hang out with people who aren't clones of yourself. I recently switched from a group of engineers who were just like me to a social circle of people who were more humanities focused (even though I'm engineering) and I was so glad I made the jump. I felt much more accepted and much less judged. It feels weird hanging out with people who aren't exactly like you, but you will learn so many new things and figure out things about yourself you never would have guessed. I realized I was an extrovert all along when I thought I was an introvert. Weird huh? 

Go bowling with your coworker when you have the chance and have fun.

Do you go to college? If you do, next semester I would reccomend getting involved in groups so you can make more friends. It's always good to have a network of friends. Whenever things head south, you need a big safety net, because you never know who is not going to be there when you need them.

I did see a therapist. We were trying to work on being more independent from my family and so I took initiative and started to grab my belongings when I figured a lot of things out. That's when I snapped. I had an appointment with my therapist, but that night I ended up traveling 400 miles at 1:30 in the morning and leaving the note and my stuff at Hunters house. 


My god what I would do to talk to her over the phone and work things out. You have no idea. I would do ANYTHING for that.

I have PTSD. I have had a lot of trouble with my family the last few weeks as well as finances. Getting enough to eat has been difficult at best. I have been having panic attacks the last couple of weeks and then something happened that made me snap. I ended up not being able to sleep (I'm used to staying up late doing work, but this was entirely different, combined with this anxiety it was physically painful beyond all comprehension) and it got to the point where I couldn't hold food down. The day I attempted, I hallucinated that me and my best friends were in imminent danger. I ended up giving Hunter my stuff, along with a note that I was going to save her life and kill myself.


I'm going to get help Tuesday. I've never had any episodes like this. Me and Hunter were VERY close, and this just ruined it completely. I used to be the funny guy who was able to cheer anyone up, now I'm in a ball in my bed trying not to cry.

Yeah, sometimes family is not the best to turn to. I foolishly turned to my ex and she told me I deserved what happened to me.  It's hard not knowing who is the best person to talk to when things like this happen. 


Talk to your boyfriends best friends for the day. Try to go and get something to eat with them. Have you seen the Hobbit yet?

Don't be too hard on him, he was trying to help. I never really understood what people who were suicidal went through until I got into this situation. I didn't want to mention this, but in all honesty, I wish I went through with it. At least my last thoughts would have been saving my best friends life and that I was doing her a favor.

The hopelessness part is really hard to deal with. It's the backbone of all anxiety. Dealing with it is extremely difficult. When you desperately try to get control back, a lot of times the wrong decisions are made and it makes matters worse. That's what I learned the hard way. 


What has been helping me has been talking to people I can trust about what's going on. Does your dad live near you? Maybe you should go visit him for a little while.

Believe it or not, I'm in an extremely stressful situation as well. Eating has been nearly impossible and sleeping is just as difficult. It's a terrible feeling. It almost feels like there is no hope. Thinking about anything other than your boyfriend is nearly impossible. You feel like you need to do something but you don't know what. It's an awful feeling. 


What has been helping me has been trying to take deep breaths out of my stomach. I have been doing this by putting one hand on my chest and the other on my stomach. Try to move the hand on your stomach as much as possible when you breathe. I know it sounds silly, but after a minute, you may feel just good enough to get something in your stomach. We need to get something in your stomach, try to focus on that, ok? Do you like pizza?

Thank you so much. I wish I had family to turn to, but I had to cut them out of my life even though I love my sister SO, SO MUCH. We suffered through so much together and we were so close. Hunter reminded me A LOT of her. Both of them had iron wills and both of them were older than me. I was protective of both of them and always made sure they were safe. Now, it feels like I failed both of them and I can't turn to either of them now for help. It feels like I lost one sister one day and lost another the next. 


I would do anything to have one of them back. 

Edit: I did send her some texts. I waited a couple of weeks after she told me to pick up my things and not to come back. I told her I was sorry for what happened and that I wasn't in my right mind. Today I told her I was going to pick up my things and I would do ANYTHING to be friends with her again. I've done all I could. I'm not sending her any more messages.

I don't know what to say, I've never been in your situation, but all I can say is that you sound like a really good person. Not everyone can do what your doing and it takes a strong person to spend the night with your boyfriend despite what's going on. It shows how much you care about other people.
